title: Charlie Parker and other Kansas City musicians he met
summary: Asked about Parker, Turner says he worked with many people and names Abie Price and drummer Baby Loving.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: How about Charlie Parker? He...uh, you knew him, didn't you?
Yeah, I met him. I met everybody.
Did you ever work with him in Kansas City?
Yeah. I worked with him...bunch o' cats. I don't remember all them people's names. I mean, I met so many people...Abie
Price...Baby Loving (?)...he's still living--Baby Loving (?)...drummer... a helluva drummer.
